title: Stage-wide author matrix and completed first runtime-author contract portion (implementation RED)
summary: The separate author runtime portion is complete for combined review with the independent graph/collision portion. Valid packed fixtures, existing real-service nine-eval controls and actual HTTP/native controls pass; the current framework lacks add kit/add dependency, so 21 owned future-path cases remain CLI-readiness RED with their later assertions unreached. No implementation, empty-handler execution or complete Gate 3 is claimed.
proves: The final owned run contains 25 cases: four actual controls pass (adopted configured body, kits-free real workerd/Collector with nine evals, held HTTP missing-mask detection, and native Node SDK execution), and 21 cases fail on unsupported CLI commands after fixture preparation succeeds. The generated-service, empty/defect handler, SDK/MCP, type/closure and mapper assertions are authored but blocked; those are not executed proofs. Static checks and cleanup pass. The separate stage inventory criterion remains failed while later precise suites are absent; full Gate 3 is not skip-green. Combined independent author review remains required before a builder starts.

captions.03-dependency-selection-red: Four checks reach unsupported dependency command; the client-boundary case first reaches unsupported kit selection. No adapter runtime proof is claimed.

captions.06-stage-completeness-open: The full-stage readiness criterion is still false: later precise author suites do not exist. This expected-pass acceptance condition has not passed.

captions.08-missing-mask-control: An independently wrong adapter performs a real held HTTP request; the guard detects quiet being reported before settlement. Other cases were unselected by the filter, not newly skipped.
captions.09-node-module-capability: Standalone pinned real workerd control: Ready, then native DatabaseSync throws Illegal constructor. The probe summary has null HTTP status because its readiness loop retried 500; it is not a failed-start or generated dependency proof.

captions.11-dependency-runtime-readiness-red: Two real controls pass; six future adapter paths stop at unsupported dependency selection. Protected Pricing/mapper behavior is not claimed implemented.
